APARTAMENT EKSKLUZIV NE SHITJE KOMPLEKSI USLUGA!!!
Ofrohet per shitje apartament 1+1 ne nje nga zonat me te mira ne Tirane.
Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne nje korridor, tualet sallon , nje dhome gjumi dhe llozhe.
Ka nje siperfaqe bruto 69 m2 dhe neto 63 m2 aktualisht eshte i dhene me qira si ambjent biznesi .
Apartamenti eshte i rinovuar shtruar me parket edhe me tavane te varura gipsi.
Zona ne te cilen ndodhet eshte nje zone shume e kerkuar per banim edhe per investim.
Apartamenti disponon dokumatcacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Per me shume informacion ju ftoje te me kontaktoni.
description_en: EXCLUSIVE APARTMENT FOR SALE USLUGA COMPLEX!!! 1+1 apartment for sale in one of the best areas in Tirana. The apartment is organized in a corridor, bathroom, living room, a bedroom and loggia. It has a gross area of ​​69 m2 and a net area of ​​63 m2. It is currently rented out as a business environment. The apartment is renovated, laid with parquet and suspended plaster ceilings. The area in which it is located is a very sought-after area for housing and investment. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation. For more information, please contact me.
